items.title: Houthis reach Perim island at mouth of Bab el-Mandeb Strait
items.title_zh: 胡塞抵达曼德海峡口佩里姆岛：红海咽喉再易手
items.summary_zh: 9月11日，也门政府多名消息人士称，伊朗支持的胡塞武装抵达曼德海峡战略岛屿佩里姆（Perim/Mayyun），并控制对岸沿海城镇杜巴卜（Dhubab）。继10日夺取穆哈港与哈尼什群岛后，胡塞进一步收紧对全球关键航运通道的钳制；联也门政府军扬言反攻夺回穆哈方向要道。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis reached the strategic island of Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait on Friday, four Yemeni government sources told Reuters, moving to tighten their grip on a vital global shipping route.
quotes.zh: 也门政府四名消息人士对路透社表示，伊朗支持的胡塞武装周五抵达曼德海峡战略岛屿佩里姆，进一步收紧对全球关键航运通道的控制。

items.title: A misalignment of AI in mathematics
items.title_zh: AI在数学中的错位：证明、优先权与语义之争
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于AI介入数学证明的长文在HN登顶，讨论从Mochizuki式孤立证明到大模型“刷分”证明的伦理边界。评论区大量争执术语与责任：模型产出可检验证书时，谁算真正作者？帖逾1200赞、近1200评。

quotes.author: tmhn2
quotes.en:
As a mathematician maybe I am a little more optimistic than this declaration.
I am thinking of Mochizuki's abc conjecture:  He worked in relative isolation, and dumped a huge incomprehensible proof on the community (to oversimplify a bit).  That's not totally unlike what might happen if AI generates a huge, incomprehensible proof of let's say RH.
Well, what is the result?  In the Mochizuki case, it was a lot of skepticism, but it also generated conferences, papers, talks in…
quotes.zh: 作为数学家，我对这份宣言可能比作者更乐观一点。我想起望月新一的abc猜想：他相对孤立地工作，然后抛出一份巨大到几乎无法理解的证明……

quotes.author: pks016
quotes.en:
I never expected this many people (on this thread) arguing semantics and what not. I know that not everyone has morality and ethics, but I didn't realize it was this bad.
I'm afraid of the ripple effect of the agenda pushed by AI companies will have. In future and even now, they say AI has significantly progressed math and scientific research in general. There is truth to this, but the narrative has done more damage (so far) to the students, researchers, and the culture of…
quotes.zh: 我没想到这个帖里会有这么多人在抠语义、绕开实质。我知道并非人人讲道德伦理，但没料到会糟到这个程度。我担心涟漪效应会一路传到……

items.title: Saudi East-West oil pipeline shut after drones from Iraq
items.title_zh: 伊拉克方向无人机袭击后，沙特东西向原油管道关停
items.summary_zh: 沙特能源部称，来自伊拉克方向的多架无人机袭击造成人员受伤后，作为霍尔木兹替代通道的东西向原油管道（East-West）采取预防性关停。该管线近月日输约400万至500万桶，约占全球供应4%–5%；消息一度把油价推近每桶110美元。沙特应伊拉克总理请求暂不报复。

quotes.author: The New York Times
quotes.en: A drone attack launched from Iraqi territory led Saudi Arabia to shut down a critical oil pipeline on Friday, heightening fears that widening clashes in the region could further disrupt energy supplies.
quotes.zh: 周五，来自伊拉克领土的无人机袭击导致沙特关停一条关键原油管道，加剧了地区冲突扩大、能源供应再受冲击的担忧。

items.title: I spent $220 on Google app ads and 60% of the installs were robots
items.title_zh: 我在谷歌应用广告花了220美元，六成安装是机器人
items.summary_zh: 独立开发者实测：投放谷歌应用广告后，约60%安装来自机器人农场。评论吐槽AdMob反过来因“无效流量”封号的黑色幽默，以及Reddit广告“只点不转化”的类似经历。帖约750赞。

quotes.author: yunusabd
quotes.en:
My favorite story:
1. Dev publishes app with Google Admob integration to the Play Store.
2. Buys Google Ads to drive traffic to the app.
3. Google Admob bans his account for invalid traffic.
https://www.reddit.com/r/admob/comments/1vzg3fu/i_paid_googl...
quotes.zh: 我最爱的故事：1）开发者上架集成AdMob的应用；2）买谷歌广告导流；3）AdMob因无效流量封他的号。

quotes.author: kimi
quotes.en:
We had a similar issue with Reddit, spent $500 and got a lot of clicks - none of them ever did anything else, not even by mistake. When we reported this behavior to Reddit, the rep who helped us set up the campaign just vanished. No answer. After a while, another rep came out and asked if we were interested in advertising on Reddit. Explained the situation and... poof! this other rep disappeared too.
My feeling is that this is systemic, and basically it's the very business…
quotes.zh: 我们在Reddit也遇到类似问题：花了500美元，点击很多，却几乎没人做别的事，甚至连误触都没有。向Reddit报了之后……

items.title: IEA cuts 2026 oil supply outlook as Gulf recovery slips to 2027
items.title_zh: IEA下调2026年石油供需展望：海湾恢复推迟到2027
items.summary_zh: 国际能源署9月11日月报称，因伊朗战事久拖、中东流量难归常态，2026年全球石油供应与需求降幅均超此前预期，海湾产量恢复被推至2027年。报告指库存缓冲持续消耗、炼油系统紧绷；沙特原油供应已降至三十多年来最低水平之一。

quotes.author: IEA / Reuters
quotes.en: Global oil supply and demand will fall further than previously thought this year, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, as a lack of progress in ending the Iran war delays the return of normal Middle East flows into 2027.
quotes.zh: 国际能源署周五表示，由于结束伊战进展不足、中东正常流量推迟到2027年才恢复，今年全球石油供需降幅将大于此前预期。

items.title: We must pace the frontier
items.title_zh: 我们必须放缓前沿：Amodei再谈节奏
items.summary_zh: Anthropic的Dario Amodei发文呼吁“pace the frontier”。HN评论尖锐：一边要求外界放慢，一边自家不开源、限制用Claude研究AI，并被指训练他人IP——“对齐失败的公开承认”成热议焦点。逾700赞、近千评。

quotes.author: cuuupid
quotes.en:
At what point do we stop engaging with Anthropic’s leadership in good faith and acknowledge their track record,
- no open weights
- can’t use claude to research AI
- train on everyone else’s IP and sell it back to them
- 8 regulatory capture attempts and counting
- so controlling they are the only US company blacklisted by the US government
This is not effective altruism / rationalism gone wild, it’s just monopolistic anti-competitive business practices masquerading as…
quotes.zh: 到什么时候我们才停止善意解读Anthropic管理层，并正视他们的履历：不开源权重、不能用Claude研究AI、训练别人的IP还卖……

quotes.author: RGS1811
quotes.en: I don’t understand all the comments assuming that RSI is the real threat here. Dario is admitting that they failed to solve alignment. Without alignment, further improvements in capability turn LLMs into wanton felony generators. This call to pace the frontier is dressed up as altruism but it’s an admission that they cannot produce a marketable product better than what they have. Pacing the frontier means the US labs have lost their moat and are dead in the water.
quotes.zh: 我不懂为什么这么多评论默认RSI才是真威胁。Dario其实是在承认他们对齐失败了。没有对齐，能力再提升只会让LLM变成……

items.title: Trump uses 9/11 anniversary remarks to defend Iran war
items.title_zh: 特朗普借9/11二十五周年讲话为对伊战争辩护
items.summary_zh: 在九一一袭击二十五周年纪念讲话中，特朗普称伊朗为“全球头号恐怖主义赞助者”，并为对伊战争辩护，称旨在阻止其获得核武器。伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬回应称指控来自“同一批恶魔”；同日红海与霍尔木兹双线承压，使纪念日演说直接卷入战时舆论。

quotes.author: Iran International
quotes.en: US President Donald Trump used remarks marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks to defend the war with Iran, saying the campaign was necessary to prevent Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons.
quotes.zh: 美国总统特朗普在纪念九一一袭击二十五周年的讲话中为对伊战争辩护，称这场行动是为阻止德黑兰获得核武器所必需。

items.title: Everyone should slow down AI development except for me
items.title_zh: 除了我以外，大家都该放慢AI开发
items.summary_zh: Xe Iaso笔记讽刺“除我之外人人减速”的安全叙事。评论指出：所谓放慢往往针对面向公众的产品，却可能拉大国家与公众的能力差距；也有人把AI安全话术比作销售话术免疫。逾700赞。

quotes.author: AaronAPU
quotes.en:
They are talking about slowing down the public facing AI development. Because then nation states can create a capabilities gap between them and the public.
Why does nobody seem to be pointing out this obvious explanation? It explains why the “we need to race China” concern suddenly vanished in the discussion.
The government can simply gag Sam, Dario, Musk on national security basis, getting them all behind the public messaging.
quotes.zh: 他们说的是放慢面向公众的AI开发。那样民族国家就能拉开与公众的能力差距。怎么好像没人指出这一点？

quotes.author: coderintherye
quotes.en: I have to wonder if some us are just much more inured to salespeople and thus also to "AI Safety" propaganda. I've yet to have a logical discussion with anyone who thinks the "AI Safety" people should be in charge and I think they just truly don't that what most them actually want is to be the one holding the keys to power.
quotes.zh: 我怀疑有些人早就对销售员脱敏，于是也对“AI安全”宣传脱敏。我还没跟认为“AI安全”派应该……的人真正逻辑谈拢过。

items.title: MBS asked Trump for US military help against Houthis; Washington offers intel
items.title_zh: 穆罕默德王储两度致电特朗普求援打胡塞，美方仅允情报支援
items.summary_zh: 知情人士称，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼周四至少两度致电特朗普，请求美方军事介入打击胡塞；华盛顿回复现阶段不愿直接动武，但可提供情报共享与目标辅助。油价政治与中期选举临近，使白宫在“保盟友”与“控油价舆论”之间更谨慎。

quotes.author: Reuters sources
quotes.en: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman called Trump at least twice on Thursday to request U.S. military help in fighting the Houthis; Washington told Riyadh it was not willing to take direct military action for now but would help with intelligence sharing and targeting.
quotes.zh: 沙特王储周四至少两度致电特朗普请求美方军事协助打击胡塞；华盛顿告知利雅得现阶段不愿直接动武，但可协助情报共享与目标指示。

items.title: google.com/goto: Google's anti-scraping update
items.title_zh: google.com/goto：谷歌反爬更新与搜索结果改写
items.summary_zh: 分析文章拆解谷歌搜索结果里的goto跳转与反爬机制。老用户感叹谷歌从“返回网页”转向“返回答案”早已死亡；另有评论回忆二十年前面试题就在追踪点击——今天的改写似乎是那时思路的终局。逾660赞。

quotes.author: lubujackson
quotes.en:
As much as I am sad that Google died like 15 years ago, I am past the mourning phase. That was when they announced they were shifting from returning websites to "returning answers" and it has been a long slide into shittification
I do enjoy using their free AI. For actual web search I actually like using Yandex. It reminds me of old Google, returning reasonable results and much less "shaping results to please our corpo-political masters". It is surprising to see how much…
quotes.zh: 尽管我难过谷歌大约十五年前就死了，我也过了哀悼期。那是他们宣布从返回网站转向“返回答案”的时候，从那以后一路……

quotes.author: rkagerer
quotes.en:
I did an interview with Google around 20 years ago, where they posed a challenge involving tracking which specific search results people click.  It's obvious in hindsight the solution required rewriting all the urls to redirect through their servers.  Note this was in the days before they already did so as a matter of course.
I failed to gain traction on the problem, because to me the very idea of doing such a thing was too reprehensible to seriously consider.  It broke an…
quotes.zh: 大约二十年前我面试谷歌时，他们出过一道追踪用户点了哪条搜索结果的题。事后看答案显然要求改写……
